text: This report recommends removing the existing school bus loading zone on the east side of Brimley Road, fronting C.D. Farquharson Junior Public School. The school no longer requires the school bus loading zone. Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) will be installing a new bus stop in the area of the existing school bus loading zone.

City Council on February 26, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council rescind the existing school bus loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., on the east side of Brimley Road, between a point 167 metres north of Pitfield Road and a point 21 metres further north.
